### P1 companion, post hoc (not pre-registered): tar = modal tape at the last sample before the first tape enters the top ten  [per_world.csv, columns arrival_step, prearrival_*]

Why: t_rep requires a heritable top-3 exemplar with share ≥ 0.5% (assay_batch.py, SHARE_MIN), so the first tape is often already modal below that share at the last sample before t_rep; this companion removes that degeneracy.
